property_summary: Invariant: only the current owner can change owner via transferOwnership — after any call to transferOwnership(newOwner) made by caller X, the owner becomes newOwner iff X was the previous owner; the mutant breaks this by allowing non-owners to set owner (some inputs where caller != initial owner will change owner).
change_summary: Delete the require statement so onlyOwner modifier no longer enforces ownership (removes the guard), allowing anyone to call transferOwnership.
